integrity.computational_evidence: Stand-alone exact integer-frequency checker; does not prove infinite theorem
integrity.proof_basis: Exact Fourier character integration and reflection pairing for sum-free sets
integrity.scientific_claim: Complete cubic-moment iff and sharp restricted-length bound

scientific_limitations: Sharp minimum is restricted to primitive diagonal one-phase constant-modulus curves; general spherical design curves are not treated.
The symmetric moment curve and its general 3-design property were known; only the full winding criterion and restricted rigidity are the contribution.
All-dimensional theorem is analytic; finite regression is supplemental, not an exhaustive proof.
title: Sharp sum-free winding rigidity for cubic spherical quadrature by one-phase Fourier curves
